source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U23: Verify incorporation,office,consent and filing responsibilities

payload.title: Check legal existence and the current authority trail
payload.core_explanation_md:
The incorporation document identifies the proposed lawful profit business, the office, the partners and designated partners, together with the required compliance statement. Registration and the certificate establish the described incorporation event. A proposed name or an unsigned agreement alone is not the same evidence.

Designated partners have the specified compliance responsibilities for filings and other statutory acts. Prior consent, identification and appointment particulars must be checked under the applicable rules. The registered office is a service address and changes require the prescribed filing. Keep legal-existence evidence separate from the LLP agreement and transaction authority: incorporation does not authorise every person to borrow or sign for the entity.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an incorporation certificate prove a particular signatory has unlimited borrowing power?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Existence and transaction authority are separate checks.

payload.stem_md: A bank receives only a proposed LLP name and treats it as proof of completed incorporation. What evidence is needed?

options.text_md: The registration/certificate record for the entity
options.explanation_md: A proposal is not the completed legal event.
It does not prove LLP existence.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A proposal is not the completed legal event.

payload.stem_md: An LLP changes its office and assumes informal email to customers alone completes the statutory change. What must be checked?

options.text_md: Whether office records are always optional
options.explanation_md: The source requires an office and filing.

options.text_md: The prescribed notice and Registrar filing
Whether all partner personal addresses also changed
options.explanation_md: That does not replace the office filing.
